pre_edit_verification.description: Verified current and gzip-decoded original source hashes against admitted baseline before editing. Reused root entry board VALID1818 and scoped lint baseline 0 errors/0 warnings; no worker board or baseline runtime.

baseline_case: Source-confirmed: optional analytics and recovery-mode accessors could reject before receipts; queue binding acquisition escaped capability handling and managed fallback; storage acquisition was incorrectly classified as post-call unknown. No failed baseline runtime claimed.
implementation: Both nonempty producers read recovery mode once before effects; only literal string 'true' opts in. An unreadable mode yields configuration_unavailable, prepared:false, known record notAttempted counts and zero messages. Empty decisions/null outcomes touch no bindings.

Optional analytics acquisition and scheduling failures cannot abort delivery. Queue acquisition is guarded inside sendAll, at most once after successful nonempty preflight; acquisition failure returns queue_unavailable with all planned records/messages notAttempted and zero acknowledgements/unknown.

Managed delivery retains frozen identity, original payload/time and existing canonical recovery for all undelivered messages. Missing/throwing storage acquisition reports storage_unavailable/notAttempted, while an unexpected rejection after invoking persistDeliveries remains conservatively unknown.

Exactly two grouped W09.08 cases cover both producer families, legacy/managed modes, actual queue/canonical bodies, count conservation, effect/getter counts, invalid/oversized preflight and safe diagnostics. Existing four selected controls retain packing bounds, uncertainty, frozen snapshots, default-off, convergence and tombstone checks.

Lead-approved existing packing-fixture correction separates already-emitted ranking_position bytes from the historical audit projection, asserts actual ranking_position is zero, retains original audit constants and verifies actual serialized bounds and roundtrip. No production dependency or additional test changed.

canonical_source.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(path-sorted array of {path,sha256}); ordering uses path.localeCompare
canonical_source.composition: Unique union of two owned outputs, 25 protected baseline pins, all 44 accepted W22.06 pins and its review; duplicate paths coalesced.
